title: User profile contract
description: Language-neutral user profile shapes shared by iOS, Android, backend, and admin. userProfile and userPrivate mirror the target Firestore collections documented in docs/firebase-data-model.md (documents keyed by Firebase UID). Firestore stores timestamps as native Timestamp values; this contract describes their ISO 8601 JSON serialization.

userProfile.description: Public user profile — Firestore `users/{uid}`. Any authenticated user can read; owner can update non-protected fields; backend (Admin SDK) manages protected fields (role, activeMember, suspended, deleted).

facebook.description: Facebook HANDLE (username or numeric profile id) — NOT a URL. The rendered link is built client-side as https://www.facebook.com/{facebook}, so the host is a constant the app owns and a member-supplied link can never redirect it. Case-folded to lower case on write. Absent (not empty string) when unset. Owner-writable; Security Rules apply this exact pattern.

instagram.description: Instagram HANDLE — NOT a URL. Rendered as https://www.instagram.com/{instagram}. Case-folded to lower case on write. Absent when unset. Owner-writable; Security Rules apply this exact pattern.

youtube.description: YouTube channel HANDLE without the leading '@' — NOT a URL and NOT a channel id. Rendered as https://www.youtube.com/@{youtube}. Case is PRESERVED (YouTube displays handles with case). Absent when unset. Owner-writable; Security Rules apply this exact pattern.

onboardingCompletedAt.description: Written by auth.completeOnboarding with a server timestamp — backend-managed only; null until onboarding is complete.

userPrivate.description: Sensitive user data — Firestore `userPrivate/{uid}`. Owner-only read and write; no other users may access this collection. Email is a contact channel, not an identity key.

notificationPreferences.description: Push/email preferences map. Intentionally left open-ended until the notifications domain contracts land (PR 2b) — the key/value shape is not yet contracted and must not be relied on for native codegen.

licenceConfirmedAt.description: Consent audit record written by auth.completeOnboarding — the member confirmed they hold a valid driving licence for the vehicle they drive. Backend-managed only; clients cannot write it (Security Rules).

ageConfirmedAt.description: LEGACY — the earlier 18+ age confirmation, superseded by licenceConfirmedAt. Not seeded on new documents, but it WAS seeded as null on every document provisioned before the licence wording landed, so a pre-change document may have it null (old onboarding never completed), set (the owner really did confirm the 18+ wording) or absent. Only a NON-NULL value is a consent record. Retained untouched; never rewritten into a licence confirmation.

termsAcceptedAt.description: Consent audit record written by auth.completeOnboarding — backend-managed only; clients cannot write it (Security Rules).

privacyPolicyAcceptedAt.description: Consent audit record written by auth.completeOnboarding — backend-managed only; clients cannot write it (Security Rules).

anonymousPartnerStatsOptIn.description: Privacy setting for anonymised partner statistics. Defaults to false (explicit opt-in); owner-editable by direct Firestore write (Security Rules enforce boolean type).

userSummary.description: Admin-facing user summary as exposed by backend list endpoints (mirrors packages/shared/src/users.ts UserSummary).
